notes.title: Version 1.0.8 is now live!
notes.content:
In this small update you will find:

- ability to run (shift key)
- vsync toggle in settings

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 is now live!
notes.content:
こんにちは！ 你好！ 안녕하세요!

We've added three new languages: Japanese, Trad. Chinese and Korean.
Fixed the bug that could prevent from progressing in 8 stones level (laser shooting the stone puzzle).

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 is now live!
notes.content:
Building on macOS is alchemy ːsteamsaltyː and sometimes the build is hit or miss. 
The last one was miss... as there were, out of nowhere, broken shader compilations which resulted in non working post processing effects.

This patch should remedy that.

Also in this patch there is updated steam plugin. The last one we did use, felt a little bit wonky.
It should be more reliable and the overlay should work properly.

For the next update:
We'll take a look on the clumsy mechanic of dragging the crystal cube.

[b]Summary[/b]

Fixed:
-  build had broken compiled shaders
- minor bugs

Maintenance:
- updated steam plugin

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is now live!
notes.content:
In this version you find bunch of fixes and one critical bug (introduced with the previous patch ːsteamfacepalmː), which prevented completing the game.

Apologies to those who were already at the end in the Planetarium level. Next run of that level will work as expected.

Some of the players had feedback about the smooth camera look. There is now toggle in the settings to turn it on or off.

[b]Summary[/b]

Fixes:
- exit button on some puzzles was misaligned
- end game loop bug

Improvements:
- option to turn on/off smooth camera look

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Just a quick info on the 2 updates that we made since the release.

As we made last minute modifications in the graphics department, few bugs arose and slip through our fingers. 

Luckily bug reporting is working and we got alerted pretty fast ːsteamhappyː


We managed to smash these bugs:

- vanishing portal in Stonehenge
- unsolvable puzzle in 8 Stones
- gamepad support in Maze
- achievements reporting

Also there is improvement in the LODs of the foliage. That nasty popping should be vastly reduced.

Enjoy the game!

Thank you for your support.
